items.definition:
a person who studies anthropology
The anthropologist studied ancient human cultures.

a device that automatically controls the steering of a vehicle
The plane was flying on autopilot.

an act of giving financial assistance to a failing business or economy
The government approved a bailout for the struggling airline.

biotechnology
The biotech industry is developing new medicines.

the blood circulating through the body
The medicine was injected directly into the bloodstream.

a type of American folk music
She loves listening to traditional bluegrass music.

the process of putting liquid into bottles
The bottling plant processes thousands of liters of soda every day.

a phrase or opinion that is overused and betrays a lack of original thought
"Time heals all wounds" is a common cliche.

the act of making an exact copy
We need to avoid duplication of effort in this project.

the final stage of a game or process
The negotiators are now in the endgame of the peace talks.

the ability to predict what will happen or be needed in the future
Her foresight in investing early paid off handsomely.

undeveloped land
The company plans to build a new factory on a greenfield site.

tendon at the back of the thigh
He pulled his hamstring during the race.

a surgical cut
The surgeon made a small incision to begin the operation.

a patient who stays in a hospital
The hospital has separate wards for inpatients and outpatients.

a person who remains loyal to the established ruler or government
The loyalists supported the king during the rebellion.

the state or period of being a man
He reached manhood and took on new responsibilities.

the cessation of menstruation
Many women experience hot flashes during menopause.

mole (unit of substance)
A mol is a unit of measurement used in chemistry.

main circuit board of a computer
The technician replaced the faulty motherboard in my computer.

monosodium glutamate
Some people avoid foods that contain MSG.

over-the-counter (medication)
You can buy this pain reliever as an OTC drug without a prescription.

female reproductive organ
The ovary produces eggs and hormones.

a politician (informal)
The seasoned politico gave a passionate speech.

private (abbreviation)
Pvt. Smith was assigned to the infantry division.

third quarter (abbreviation)
The company's earnings for Q3 exceeded expectations.

a plan or guide for a journey or project
The company presented a roadmap for its future product development.

rosary
She prayed the rosary every evening.

summary; overview
Can you give me a quick rundown of what happened?

the state of being older or higher in rank
Her seniority in the company gave her certain privileges.

the action of ending a connection or relationship; severance pay
He received a large severance package when he left the company.

a cover for the blade of a knife or sword
He drew the sword from its leather sheath.

a product, idea, or organization that is developed from a larger one
The TV show was a successful spinoff of the original movie.

a narrow strip of material, especially leather or fabric
She wore flip-flops with a leather thong.

a period of time during which something is projected to take place
We need to complete the project within a strict timeframe.

the region of the Earth surrounding the Equator
The climate in the tropics is generally hot and humid.

an emperor of Russia before 1917
The last Russian tsar was Nicholas II.

a wealthy, powerful person in business or industry
He became a shipping tycoon by the age of forty.

a loud and confused noise or disturbance
The crowd was in an uproar after the controversial decision.

the action or state of keeping careful watch for possible danger or difficulties
Constant vigilance is required to prevent security breaches.

a person from a Western country
Many Westerners find traditional Eastern customs fascinating.

a person who whistles
The whistler walked down the street, humming a tune.

the sequence of industrial, administrative, or other processes through which a piece of work passes from initiation to completion
We need to optimize our workflow to improve efficiency.

a person who practices yoga
The yogi demonstrated a difficult pose.

an attack made by aircraft
The military launched an airstrike on the enemy's position.

the action or fact of achieving a goal or reaching a specified standard
Her academic attainment was exceptional.

the state or fact of being the writer of a book, article, or document, or the creator of a work of art
The authorship of the ancient manuscript is still debated.

a heavily armored warship with a large main battery
The old battleship is now a museum.

a knife-like weapon that attaches to the muzzle of a rifle
Soldiers fixed their bayonets before the charge.

a sudden and unwelcome surprise; a very attractive woman
The news of his resignation was a complete bombshell.

a person from Great Britain
Many Britons enjoy a cup of tea in the afternoon.

extreme tiredness, often from work
She experienced severe burnout after working 80-hour weeks for months.

the act of buying a controlling share in a company
The company offered a generous buyout package to its long-term employees.

a warning or proviso of specific stipulations, conditions, or limitations
He gave his approval, but with a few caveats.

a small group of people, with shared interests or other features in common, who spend time together and do not readily allow others to join them
The popular girls formed an exclusive clique.

the petals of a flower, typically forming a whorl within the sepals and enclosing the reproductive organs
The bright yellow corolla of the daffodil stood out in the garden.

water (French, used in English phrases)
She sprayed on some eau de parfum before leaving.

a wall or bank of earth or stone built to prevent a river flooding an area or to carry a road or railway
The train tracks ran along the top of the embankment.

young female horse
The jockey rode the spirited filly to victory.

adherence to rules or customs
Shaking hands is a common formality when meeting someone new.

permissible according to Islamic law
The restaurant serves only halal meat.

a head covering worn by Muslim women
Many Muslim women choose to wear a hijab.

the process of incubating eggs or bacteria
The eggs are currently in the incubation period.

a type of evergreen shrub or tree
The gin was flavored with juniper berries.
